svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: 02 - Accounts, community and safety
svg.desc: Email stays primary. Telegram phone is explicit and allowlisted, not bot-message OTP. Sessions and deletion keep ownership checks.
